# ledger account type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ledgerAccountType`](gmeow-ledgerAccountType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ledgerAccountType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of ledger account — one of the open [`LedgerAccountType`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerAccountType.md) values (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense). Functional: a ledger account has one canonical type.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:LedgerAccount`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerAccount.md) -> [`gmeow:LedgerAccountType`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerAccountType.md); functional
